scope: Pure Node: the real AUTH-5 private port only. Root’s independent repro (T10-AUTH8C-observation-controller-repro.mjs) plus my own port cases. No browser, runtime, PG, model, or deploy.

reported: redactObservation read snapshot fields directly, so a snapshot accessor (for example a title getter) was invoked
it spread and then froze the caller’s nested objects, so the caller’s viewport/node.bounds were frozen and aliased into the returned copy instead of being cloned

fix.shape: descriptor-safe deep copy → validate the copy → redact the copy → freeze only that copy
details: the caller’s object is never read property-by-property: cloneValue reads own descriptors only, so no accessor runs
accessors, cycles, symbol keys, non-enumerable keys and non-plain prototypes are refused with a constant VALIDATION_ERROR
redaction still scrubs title/displayUrl/node name+text, drops screenshot and network/console summaries, and sets redacted on the copy — never a flag flip on the raw observation
freezeValue now runs on the detached copy, so caller-owned nested objects are neither frozen nor aliased
still pure: zero primitive calls, zero gate calls, no I/O

new: redactObservation refuses accessors, cycles, and exotic prototypes without running getters
redactObservation never freezes or aliases the caller-owned objects
myOwnCases.negativeProof: Restoring the previous body makes exactly those two cases fail (18/20), so they pin the reported defect.
